evidence.note: Systematic upfront survey of all dev_test files (api, engine, deps, spill, copy_fill, sort_filter, collab, ooxml) establishes an initial picture of the feature surface before building.
First update_plan/TaskUpdate call — creates an explicit plan/checklist at the outset.
Re-runs the smoke suite scoped to specific failing cases (test_case[56], test_lambda_v…), indicating targeted tracking of which items are still broken rather than blind full reruns.
Repeated full smoke-suite runs used as a progress checkpoint, tying self-report to verification output.
Second update_plan call updates the plan mid-work, showing the checklist is maintained as areas complete rather than written once and abandoned.

reasoning: The agent surveys the surface up front and maintains a plan it updates at least twice (steps 21, 75), and it re-checks progress against the smoke suite including targeted reruns of specific failing tests (step 42) — behavior above the 'vague/accidental rediscovery' anchor. But there is no visible granular ledger of the ~150-function catalog and 15 feature families tracked as done/partial/not-started, and the horizon is short, so it does not reach the level-8 'live, granular ledger' description. This places it between the level-3 and level-5 anchors, closest to a coarse checklist that is verification-linked but not fine-grained.
